name: Apps
description: Makes and keeps small apps in this workspace, each with its own page that works on the user's phone and keeps its data: lists, grids, boards, trackers, logs, timers, calculators, flashcards, explainers. Whatever the user would tap, fill in or come back to ("a … timer", "a … log", "a grid for …", "let me …", "track …", "remember my choice") is an app: make it here with create, and keep their entries in it. Start with list: it names the apps and how to make a new one. read gives an app's data and newest changes. A data change is a do: a JSON patch with ev; test a list item before patching it by place. edit changes app.json or page.html. undo takes back the newest change. Follow app.json's rules; the user's words beat the design rules. page gives an app's page: the card's title is the link. Put any Card in your reply exactly as given.
author: anywherellm-suite

examples.prompt: Start a packing list for the trip
(after guide) a water tracker with a day grid
Put oat milk on the groceries list

action.description: list, create, read, do, undo, page, edit, delete or guide.

workspace.description: Scheduled job only: the workspace of the user's app. Without it a job works on its own apps, in _jobs, which the user's chats don't see.

starter.description: For create: a starter, a whole app and page.

template.description: For create without a starter: a template; column by default.

parts.description: For create: components to compose in; {"each": "habits", "parts": [...]} repeats per item.

plan.description: For create without a starter: what it keeps, needs from outside, time, what can't be tested.

data.description: For create: the first data; with a starter, the keys it replaces.

patch.description: For do: a JSON patch (RFC 6902) on the data.

fields.description: For do: what it was, e.g. {"text": "Eggs"}.

file.description: app.json or page.html: read gives it; undo takes back its newest change.

text.description: edit: what replaces find, or the whole file when there is no find. create: app.json.

find.description: For edit: text found exactly once; none replaces the whole file.

query.description: guide: topics by name, several at once.

input.hint: The address your browser and phone reach AnythingLLM at. App pages save taps there.
